name: buurtpreventie
description: Plan neighbourhood watch rounds, find a walking buddy and report back, through the MCP server of your own Buurtpreventie app

server_url.title: App address
server_url.description: The address of your Buurtpreventie app, such as https://buurtpreventie.example.org, without /mcp

token.title: API token
token.description: An API token you made in the app (bpt_…), with the scope read, and write to sign up or report back
